acceptanceRules: Specification/demo/test existence is not an automatic or visual pass.
Retained candidates bind to their own immutable source/artifact identities; no current whole-worktree or cross-platform equivalence is inferred.
No baseline is established; no two consecutive ordinary pixel comparison runs are proved.
Final same-candidate complete unified Windows and local Linux entries remain pending for every product.
Historical default inventory never contributes to current state/size/environment matrix acceptance.
